Sequence shot 7 (12:00-14:00): return to wide, [SUBJECT] and [CONTEXT] in final stillness, [STYLE] light culminating in soft golden wash. Fade.

architecture.catalogStorage: 25 entries in original order; 23 distinct banks. Wes and Coppola reference Standard plus their explicit visual direction.
architecture.outputs: Stills: ten separately copyable image prompts and named Copy all list; no invented grid. Moving: one video sequence. Custom finals independent per template/mode/provider.
architecture.characterLimit: Count entire visible/copied string including newlines (JS UTF-16 length). Never truncate. Over limit: preserve full text, show actual/max, copy exact text; bridge/send disabled until final fits. User may edit or raise limit.
architecture.pacing: Integer seconds 1..15; plans 1..30. Round cumulative boundaries to centiseconds, not segment durations; end equals duration*100. Warn if mean shot duration <0.5s without claiming provider limits.
architecture.repetition: Preserve prefix for 1..7 and explicit cyclic reuse for 8..30. Display cycle/sourceBeat and warning. Opening-shot references mean original opening framing; no invented story.
architecture.references: Fixed slots 1..9 with gaps. Image ID, subject and context persist together. Main setting never falls back to secondary subject. List all active refs; 3..9 support descriptions but are not locally staged actions.
architecture.textOnly: Provide explicit subject/context fields without images. Empty values produce editable descriptive placeholders; block send until resolved.
architecture.inputSubstitution: One replacement pass with callback; dollar tokens, bracketed text, HTML-like input and Unicode remain literal. Render textContent; copy persisted visible final.
architecture.style: Blank style: source-matched when refs exist, neutral cinematic otherwise. Wes stills omit whip pans. Preserve original notes for AI use.
architecture.import: Explicit ordered file selection; folders sort by relative path using code-point ordering, preview and choose up to nine. Reject overflow before replacing any slot. Decode before atomic commit, report read errors, never randomize. Replacement clears old descriptions unless explicitly retained.
architecture.async: Capture setup/revision/slot ID; discard late reads/results on target change. One explicit request at a time; remove input-triggered AI and queued busy retries. Errors preserve prior final.
architecture.persistence: Reuse validated A4 media conventions. Media and custom finals survive duplicate/version/export/restore/reset. Reset controls while retaining personal media/finals.
architecture.bridge: Current V6 tools pass references:[]; do not claim transfer until roundtrip-tested. If unsupported, clearly expose prompt-only handoff and required attachment for referenced drafts. Stills use image, sequences video; dialect must not invent a generation model or resolution.
architecture.aiAvailability: No /api/ai/video-direct route currently in V6 server. Keep payload contract; UI unavailable until an authorized service is wired/tested. No BYOK secrets in setups or messages.
architecture.aiPayload: Snapshot model (dialect), model_ai (configured service), mode, director, intent, durationSec, shotCount, references {ref,description,imageBase64}. GO ACTION does not consume the local shot draft; no claim of AI enforcing its beat order.
architecture.aiAdoption: Check nonempty result and length. Verify actual count/duration if structured; free text with unverified structure stays explicitly unverified. Stale/error responses cannot replace previous final.
architecture.build: Movable/renamable tool with stable IDs. Deck and Backstage fixed.
